name: arka-fastdev
summary: Execute exactly one calculated FastDev guided rework phase.
useWhen: Use when a Feature uses arka-norn-fastdev, or when `arka-norn fastdev next` identifies the next phase.
doNotUseWhen: Do not use for a different calculated phase, an unverified Agent scope, or to bypass schema and business validation.
triggers: Use when a Feature uses arka-norn-fastdev, or when `arka-norn fastdev next` identifies the next phase. English triggers include "continue the Feature" and "run the next phase". French triggers include "continuer la Feature" and "exécuter la prochaine étape". Resolve locale, Project, Feature, Agent and phase through the CLI before acting.

interface.shortDescription: Execute exactly one calculated FastDev guided rework phase.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $arka-fastdev to execute only the currently calculated phase.

whenToUse: Use when a Feature uses arka-norn-fastdev, or when `arka-norn fastdev next` identifies the next phase.
The work must produce one signed and mechanically validated artifact.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for a different calculated phase, an unverified Agent scope, or to bypass schema and business validation.
The current Agent identity or session cannot be verified.

inputs.name: session_id
inputs.description: Specialized Agent session supplied by Product control.

inputs.name: agent_id
inputs.description: Explicit active identity; otherwise use the Project session binding.

inputNotes: Never infer the phase from filenames. Machine-readable CLI data is the source of truth. Canonical phases: rework_brief, development_report, delivery_audit, delivery_validation.

procedure.title: Resolve locale and verified context
procedure.content: Run `arka-norn locale show --json`, `feature show`, `agent current` and `agent sessions`. Reply in the active display locale. Keep contract keys in English and set `content_locale` to the prose locale.

procedure.title: Read one calculated action
procedure.content: Run `arka-norn fastdev next <feature> --session <session-id> --json`. Use its stable codes, parameters, expected artifact and suggested command without guessing from display prose. Stop if the action is null.

procedure.title: Produce the bounded artifact
procedure.content: Execute only the proposed scaffold command. Replace every sentinel, preserve the specialized session, satisfy code, functional, UX and security evidence where applicable, and never modify another documentary phase.

procedure.title: Validate and stop
procedure.content: Run `arka-norn pipeline validate <feature> --document <file> --json`, then rerun `arka-norn fastdev next <feature> --session <session-id> --json` only to observe the transition. Report the next action without executing it.

outputFormat: Report the verified Project, Feature, Agent/session, locale, executed phase, signed document, validation result, evidence and observed next command. Do not execute a second phase in the same invocation.
